findings.text: The new condition no longer forces x64 on darwin/arm64 for v14.17.0–v14.x, even though the added comment says no arm64 binaries exist before v16. `nvm install 14.17.0` on an M1 Mac now requests node-v14.17.0-darwin-arm64.tar.gz, which doesn't exist, so the download 404s or falls back to a source build instead of using the x64 build under Rosetta.

The range logic is convoluted. The `15.0.0 <= v < 16.0.0` clause is redundant with the first, and the combined condition leaves a gap exactly where binaries are missing (14.17.0 to 14.x). Any version in that gap, such as 14.21.3, gets the wrong arch.
